_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Wòdzi le {start_chips} chipi
• Single deck of 52 karta (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Wòwɔ le dealer (house)
• Xexlẽ ƒe Ultimate Texas Hold'em structure: wòdzi ANTE kple BLIND bets, wòwɔ 2 hole karta, decide on optional PLAY bets across the betting phases, then reveal community karta kple compare wòwɔ ƒe best 5-karta hand le dealer’s. Wòwɔ ƒe goal nye maximize wòwɔ ƒe winnings (when wòwɔ have the better hand), while minimizing wòwɔ ƒe losses (when wòwɔ have the worse hand).
• Game ends when wòwɔ reach 0 chipi or below at start of xexlẽ (LOSS) or complete 1000 xexlẽ with chipi (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet every xexlẽ
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet every xexlẽ
• PLAY: Optional bet during gameplay. Throughout the xexlẽ, wòwɔ may choose ONLY ONE of the following: (${ante4} if done at PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} if done at FLOP, or ${ante} if done at RIVER. Can also fold at river, giving up on the hand, and making no bet.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Wòwɔ receive 2 face-up karta (wòwɔ ƒe hole karta)
• Dealer receive 2 face-down karta (hidden from wòwɔ)
• 5 community karta are dealt face-down initially
• Community karta are revealed progressively through the game phases

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer must have at least a PAIR (2 karta of same rank) to qualify, using the 2 karta in their hand and the 5 community karta.
• Dealer qualification affects the betting outcomes, as will be explained later.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) or [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY bet, reveals first 3 community karta
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveals first 3 community karta

📋 FLOP:
  • If 4x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-reveals last 2 community karta)
  • If no 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) or [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY bet, reveals last 2 community karta
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveals last 2 community karta

📋 RIVER:
  • If 4x or 2x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-proceeds to showdown)
  • If no prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) or [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY bet, proceeds to showdown
  • [fold]: Give up hand, lose ANTE and BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • All karta revealed and evaluated
  • Best 5-karta hand from 7 karta (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets settled according to payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer doesn't qualify: PUSH (bet returned)
  • Dealer qualifies & wòwɔ win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualifies & wòwɔ lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected by dealer qualification
  • Wòwɔ win: Bet returned and additional payout based on wòwɔ ƒe hand strength
  • Wòwɔ lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: No additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected by dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Wòwɔ ƒe best hand vs Dealer's best hand
  • Wòwɔ win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Wòwɔ lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 of same suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive karta of same suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 karta of same rank
  4. Full House: 3 of a kind + 2 of a kind
  5. Flush: 5 karta of same suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive karta
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 karta of same rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs of different ranks
  9. One Pair: 2 karta of same rank
  10. High Card: Highest karta wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] or [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] or [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] or [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] or [c]: Check (no additional bet)
• [fold] or [f]: Fold (give up hand)
• [skip] or [s]: Skip to next phase (when no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high karta) often justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands may push if dealer doesn't qualify
• BLIND bet can be very profitable with strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch wòwɔ ƒe chipi stack! If it goes to 0 or below at start of xexlẽ, wòwɔ lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE and BLIND bets are mandatory every xexlẽ
• PLAY bets are optional and strategic
• Make sure wòwɔ input the correct action, and only one action at a time.
